_doc: Per-fixture node-size ratchet for the object DOT-parity suite (decisions.md#d4). Fixtures listed here are structurally EQUAL but their maxSizeDeltaIn (inches) is not yet 0; the test asserts delta <= pinned value + 1e-6, so a delta may only shrink. Phase L size iterations lower entries to 0 and DELETE them (absent slug = 0 required). Values captured 2026-07-11 at ratchet creation; re-measured 2026-07-11 after Phase L iter 7 (raw-display object member rows). RE-BASELINED 2026-08-10: the 2026-07-11 pins were badly stale -- 14 fixtures had reached exactly 0 and are DELETED per this file's own convention, and 7 more were lowered to their measured value. No pin was raised. Remaining entries are grouped by IDENTICAL delta, which is the signature of a shared mechanism rather than N independent bugs.
